bull_bear.body: - Shareholding is Promoter & Promoter Group-dominated at 71%, with DII at 2%, FII at 3% and Public at 23%, as reported in the presentation.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Positions itself as India's First IVF company to list on the stock market, India's No. 1 IVF Clinic per a Times of India Health Survey, India's First IVF chain to introduce AI in infertility treatment, and India's First IVF company to receive the European Quality Award for highest quality standards.
- "Our Moat, Our Momentum" frames eleven compounding strengths built over 15+ years - established/trusted brand, clinical excellence, strong clinical leadership, integrated care platform, pan-India presence, global reach, multi-channel patient acquisition, scalable growth platform, SOP-driven operations, innovation-led care, and emotional counselling support - claiming it has already crossed every major industry entry barrier (regulatory compliance, high capital/infra costs, brand trust, tech/R&D dependence, ethical sensitivities, consolidation, skilled manpower).
- Claims a global patient base, having successfully treated patients from 30+ countries including Canada, UK, Middle East, Africa, Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand, positioning Gaudium as a fertility-care destination beyond India.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

deepdive.thesis: Gaudium IVF positions itself as India's first stock-exchange-listed IVF chain and the No.1 ranked IVF clinic (Times of India survey), built on a 15+ year, AI-powered (SiD & ERICA), SOP-driven hub-and-spoke platform that it is now scaling pan-India to address a hugely underpenetrated fertility-care market.
